name: Media Middle Manager
description: One place to browse and manage your media stack. It connects to Radarr, Sonarr, Overseerr, qBittorrent, Tautulli, Plex and Tdarr and shows your library as posters, with ratings, files, tags, sizes and watch history for every title. Filter and sort by size, tags or what nobody watches, and clean up whole titles or single episodes so they stay removed (request, monitoring, files and torrents), with Radarr and Sonarr keeping the history. Requesting new media is planned.

notes.text: The first visit asks you to create an account. Until you do, anyone who can reach port 3001 can claim it, so do that straight away, and use HTTPS if it is reachable beyond your LAN.

Add your Radarr, Sonarr, Overseerr, qBittorrent, Tautulli, Plex and Tdarr connections under Settings after install. Everything is stored in the SQLite database /opt/media-middle-manager_data/mmm.db, with API keys encrypted using /opt/media-middle-manager_data/secret.key. Back that key file up separately: without it the stored keys cannot be recovered.
